population.sourcePopulation: all source occurrences belonging to the 12 holdout cases
population.requirementStatus: requiredMappings only; optional and expected-ambiguous mappings excluded
population.duplicateHandling: Each required physical-column mapping occurrence is counted once. Repeated canonical signals in different cases or columns remain separate observations; source reuse is not deduplicated across corpus cases.

holdoutRequiredRecallReconciliation.difference: The 60-item measure includes every required semantic mapping in holdout cases, including non-core and partially supported signals. It is a corpus coverage diagnostic, not the MVP release-gate denominator.

releaseGateRationale: The MVP roadmap explicitly gates core MVP signal recall on held-out in-domain files. The 22-occurrence calculation is therefore canonical and its 90% threshold is unchanged.
